title: Why was my ATM fee not rebated?
summary: Explains why an ATM fee was not rebated: you hit the $30 monthly rebate cap (additional ATM operator fees that month aren’t rebated); the charge wasn’t coded as an ATM operator fee; the transaction posted outside the eligible rebate window; or the withdrawal was at an ineligible location/terminal type. It also instructs you to review your statement vs. the $30 cap, verify the fee label and keep the receipt, and contact support with date, location, and a receipt copy showing the surcharge.
faqs: Why didn’t I get an ATM fee rebate for this transaction?
Did I reach the $30 monthly rebate cap, and could that prevent rebating additional fees?
What if the surcharge wasn’t labeled/coded as an ATM operator fee by the merchant or network?
What does “outside the eligible rebate window” mean for my ATM transaction?
Which ATM locations or terminal types are not eligible for rebates?
What information should I provide to support if I still think a rebate is due?
keywords: contact support with date and location
